items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jimmy Bell was one that played at the Savoy Ballroom and places like that

ctx.x: Yeah. There were a couple of guys that played in a dancehall, a couple of bands that would… not to really note. Jimmy Bell was one that played at the Savoy Ballroom and places like that but Earl Hines got the Grand Terrace, and Ed Fox…
